user.title: Connect to SA Power Networks
user.description: Sign in with the email address and password you use for SAPN's Your Meter Data portal.

meters.title: Choose meters
meters.description:
Select the meters to import. Their complete history is imported in the background after setup.

Basic and manually read meters have no interval data and are not listed. Excluded: {excluded}.

channels.title: Channels for {meter}
channels.description: Name each channel found in this meter's recent data and choose how it is used. Typically E1 is general consumption, E2 is controlled load, and B1 is solar export. Each channel becomes its own statistic for the Energy dashboard.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to SA Power Networks
reauth_confirm.description: SAPN rejected the saved login. Enter the current password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: SAPN rejected the email address or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SAPN portal. Try again later.
error.portal_error: The SAPN portal did not respond as expected. It may be down for maintenance; try again later.
error.no_interval_meters: This account has no meters with interval data.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This SAPN account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The SAPN login has been updated.

meters.title: Choose meters
meters.description:
Select the meters to import. Newly selected meters and channels have their complete history imported in the background.

Basic and manually read meters have no interval data and are not listed. Excluded: {excluded}.

channels.title: Channels for {meter}
channels.description: Name each channel and choose how it is used. Renaming a channel keeps its statistic and history.
